map_openai_params: map OpenAI image edit parameters to Stability AI API format with size-to-aspect_ratio conversion
transform_image_edit_request: transform an OpenAI-style image edit request into Stability AI multipart form-data format
transform_image_edit_response: transform a Stability AI image edit response into OpenAI-compatible ImageResponse format

get_complete_url: build the complete Stability AI API endpoint URL from model name and optional api_base override
